page.overview:
What is Inaya's ship?

Inaya's ship was a personal starship made by princess Inaya as a secret before revealing it at the library opening ceremony on her homeworld Hazun.

Inaya's ship first appeared in the episode "The Secret Ship" from the second season of the animated series Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures.
